## v1.1.0 - Reliability & safety update

### Safety
- Fixed a command-injection vulnerability in app launching (no more shell interpretation, dangerous characters rejected)
- Closing apps now requires confirmation and protects system and Nova processes - a short or vague app name is refused
- Killing processes refuses Nova, Python, and system processes
- No more double confirmation dialogs - Nova asks once, then acts

### Fixes
- Web searches and YouTube searches produce correct links (proper URL encoding)
- Running Python code now works in the built Nova.exe
- No longer crashes at startup on machines without an audio device
- API key setup can no longer hang forever (5 minute timeout)
- Fixed a race condition where pressing the hotkey and the button together could start two listening sessions at once
- Window centering now uses your real screen size
- Process details no longer crash on missing data
- Snap window validates left/right before moving anything

### Install
Download Nova.exe, run it, and sign in with your Gemini API key (Settings or on first launch).

High-performance, secure cross-platform clipboard manager written in Rust with hotkeys and QR extraction.

**v1.1.0 — one-click install + a lot of new accessibility.** The release package now bundles BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP x64), so installing is just: copy the contents of the zip into your Among Us folder and launch. No manual BepInEx setup.

## Install
- Download `AmongUsAccessibilityMod-v1.1.0.zip` (recommended — BepInEx included)
- Copy **everything inside** the `AmongUsAccessibilityMod` folder into your Among Us game folder (Steam: right-click Among Us → Manage → Browse local files), merge folders when asked
- Launch the game once, reach the main menu, close it, then launch again
- Already have BepInEx 6? Just copy `Among.Us.Accessibility.Mod.dll` into `BepInEx/plugins/`

## What's new in this release

**New keys**
- `V` — locate the nearest vent (direction + distance); inside a vent, Left/Right/Up choose destinations, Escape climbs out; while dead, cycles spectate targets
- `F1` — speak the full keybind list
- `F2` — mute/unmute all announcements (30 s)
- `Ctrl+,` / `Ctrl+.` — repeat the previous/next announcement

**New accessibility**
- Lobby readout: players, host settings (map, impostors, tasks), start countdown
- Meeting phase: roster (who's alive/dead), vote lock-in, vote countdown (10/5/3/1), vote progress, vote results
- Ghost spectate: cycle living players to follow while dead
- Vent navigation for Impostors/Engineers
- Quick-chat menu announcements
- Vitals monitor and Shapeshifter picker minigame support
- Task bar milestones (50/75/100%), kill cooldown callouts, sabotage countdowns, own-death announcement
- Every announcement type is now configurable (19 toggles in `BepInEx/config/greenbean.amongusaccessibilitymod.cfg`)

**Fairer tasks**
- Swipe Card, Clean O2 Filter, Clean Vents no longer fail on early release — they finish on their own
- Calibrate Distributor: press Space to arm a dial, it locks on its next pass

Full details in `CHANGELOG.txt`. Website: https://demon-of-fire.github.io/demon-of-fire/mods/among-us.html
Accessibility mod for Among Us that makes the game playable by ear for blind and visually impaired players - BepInEx plugin with NVDA/Tolk speech, spatial audio cues, and full keyboard navigation.

## v1.1.0 - Performance & accuracy overhaul

Rebuilt from the ground up to fix lag and misreads.

### Performance
- Screen-change detection: AI vision only runs when the screen actually changes (was running constantly)
- Full-frame reads are now 2.4x faster (downscaled smartly before OCR)
- Single shared screen-capture session - no more stutter from repeated grabs

### Accuracy
- New selection detection: reliably finds the highlighted menu item
- Scoreboard/overlay filter keeps the score, clock and events (GOAL, HALF TIME) while dropping ad and UI noise
- Better state detection: knows menus from matches, even night stadiums
- Menu reading: 'Selected: X. Options: 1 Y, 2 Z'

### New
- F6: read match state (score, clock) at any time
- Auto-reader announces score changes and match events (kick off, goal, half time, match end)
- F5 full screen read now works reliably

### Shortcuts
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| F1 | Read menus (with selected item detection) |
| F2 | AI summary of current screen |
| F3 | Read detail panel (emails/transfers/settings) |
| F4 | Toggle auto-reader |
| F5 | Full screen read |
| F6 | Read match state |

### Installation
1. Download FC26_Accessibility_Mod.exe and nvdaControllerClient64.dll
2. Place both in the same folder
3. Run the exe as administrator
4. Start FC 26 in Borderless Windowed mode

## FC 26 Accessibility Mod (Vision AI)

Screen reader for EA Sports FC 26 using on-device AI. No cloud, no API key.

### Features
- **Florence-2** vision AI for screen understanding
- **EasyOCR** neural network OCR for accurate text reading
- **NVDA** speech output (with Windows SAPI fallback)
- Auto-reader detects highlighted menu items
- Automatically sets game to Borderless Windowed mode

### Shortcuts
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| F1 | Read menus (with selected item detection) |
| F2 | AI summary of current screen |
| F3 | Read detail panel (emails/transfers/settings) |
| F4 | Toggle auto-reader |
| F5 | Full screen read |

### Requirements
- Windows 10/11
- NVDA screen reader (recommended)
- Internet connection on first run (downloads ~460MB AI model, cached after)

### Installation
1. Download `FC26_Accessibility_Mod.exe` and `nvdaControllerClient64.dll`
2. Place both files in the same folder
3. Run the exe as administrator
4. Start FC 26 in Borderless Windowed mode
